headline: Fresh independent re-derivation: fixed-0.40-cut headline claims 5/5 candidates NOVEL. Under a genuine distribution-free conformal novelty test (Vovk-Gammerman-Shafer 2005) calibrated on the SAME SHA-locked reference corpus's own LOO NN-Tanimoto distribution, only 4/5 reach significance at the standard alpha=0.05 level (smoothed p-value convention); 4/5 under the strict rank-fraction convention. Candidate(s) failing significance at alpha=0.05: ['DDS'].
interpretation: The shipped KPI's flat claim 'REAL FINDING: 5/5 candidates classified NOVEL' and its passed=true metric 'all_candidates_classified_novel_below_0_40_threshold' do NOT survive a defensible, distribution-free statistical novelty test at the standard alpha=0.05 significance level: DDS (fixed-cut NN Tanimoto 0.3929, only 0.0071 below the now-unsupported 0.40 cut) fails to reach conformal significance (p=0.1149 > 0.05) under BOTH tested p-value conventions. The true, defensible statement this corpus supports is 4/5 NOVEL at alpha=0.05, with DDS a genuine borderline case -- not 5/5. This closes the loop the citation-provenance fire opened (2026-08-14): the 0.40 cut had no real literature source, and now that it is replaced with a real distribution-free test, its headline count changes.
